title: Access service token disabled after leak detection and re-enable returns 409 or rotation returns 400
symptoms: Service token suddenly disabled and account administrators receive an email
Rotating the secret with previous_client_secret_expires_at set returns HTTP 400
Services using the old client secret start getting denied
cause: GitHub secret scanning reports Access service token secrets found in public repos and Access disables the token. A leaked token cannot be re-enabled until its secret is rotated, and leaked secrets get no rotation grace period, so the old secret is discarded immediately.
fix: Rotate the secret without previous_client_secret_expires_at, update every service with the new secret, then re-enable the token. Avoid committing secrets, which use the cfast_ prefix for secrets created on or after 2026-08-26.
apply: Rotate the service token via API with no previous_client_secret_expires_at field in the body, then re-enable the token after updating consumers.
affected: Access service tokens, behavior documented 2026-11-11; cfast_ format for Client Secrets created from 2026-08-26
